verdict.rationale: The only programmatic surface in the evidence is the Cake MCP connection for Claude, Codex, Cursor or other MCP clients. That connection is explicitly read-only and covers queries about shareholders, option pools, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes. This falls far short of the UI, which handles issuances, splits, buy-backs, conversions, certificates, vesting setup and capital raises, and probes found no public OpenAPI/Swagger spec. missing for 10: any write or mutation capability via API/MCP, a documented public REST API or OpenAPI spec, parity for UI workflows such as issuances, splits, buy-backs, certificates, e-signing and raise modelling, and independent corroboration.
